text:
Paul (support): FYI — customer acme-corp reports several dashboard widgets stuck on a spinner, nothing loads. They say it started ~09:10 UTC and UI shows failed network requests (analytics API 5xx). Anyone available?

Sophie (eng-oncall): I'm on it. Can you share org id and which dashboard/widgets? Any request IDs or sample time?

Paul (support): Org: acme-corp (org_88). Dashboard: revenue-over-time. User timestamp 2026-03-16T09:12Z. I grabbed a trace id from the browser: q-9f3a. Screenshot uploaded: https://files.redwood/internal/shot123.png

Sophie (eng-oncall): Thanks. I'm already seeing elevated proxy latency 09:08-09:18 and a burst of 504s. There's a recent optimizer deploy at 2026-03-16T02:12 that correlates. Triggering a rollback now. @infra-bot please roll back analytics-optimizer.

infra-bot: rollback initiated for service analytics-optimizer from v2.3.4 to v2.3.3. Deployment ID: dep-5721. Rollback in progress, ETA ~2m.

Leo (eng-infra): Also noticing ClickHouse readpool hitting connection limit — many short-lived queries piling up. I'm increasing pool size and cycling readpool worker to free sockets.

Sophie (eng-oncall): Paul, can you reproduce from your side with a curl so we have a deterministic repro? Include the X-Trace header if possible.

Paul (support): Repro steps I ran locally (redacted token):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \n  -H \"X-Trace: q-9f3a\" \n  -X POST https://analytics.redwood.internal/v1/query \n  -d '{"query":"SELECT sum(amount) FROM metrics WHERE org_id=\"org_88\"","range":"1h"}' \
  -v
```
Response I got:

HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "upstream read timeout after 30s", "phase": "proxy" }

Sophie (eng-oncall): That matches the handler logs: `ERROR handler: request timed out after 30s` then proxy returns 504. Hotfix: I'm extending backend proxy timeout to 60s for analytics routes as immediate mitigation while rollback completes.

Paul (support): Notified the customer and gave workaround (refresh after 30-60s). They asked about SLA credits — sending to support queue for escalation.

infra-bot: Rollback completed for analytics-optimizer. New active version: v2.3.3.

Leo (eng-infra): Readpool restarted and connection limit raised. Post-rollback metrics: 200s for queries restored, no more spike in queue depth.

Sophie (eng-oncall): Can you confirm UI now?

Paul (support): Confirmed with customer: dashboard widgets loaded and metrics back. They verified revenue-over-time now renders. Marking support case as mitigated. Leaving incident open for postmortem (INC-2026-0316-analytics-timeout). :thumbsup:

Sophie (eng-oncall): Filing short blameless postmortem — will include deploy gating, connection limits, and a playbook for throttling vs timeout tuning.

Paul (support): Thanks all. Closing the customer-facing loop.
